b6ded2cae1cfa79e.description: About the Role Canonical is expanding its Embedded Devices Software Solution Sales team globally and is seeking an Embedded Devices Software Solution Sales Account Manager. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on prospecting sales and strategic account development within mission-critical industries. The position requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in sales, specifically with embedded Linux and RTOS. Role Responsibilities The Account Manager will be responsible for an annual bookings quota and will position and sell open source, services, and software solutions. This involves building trusted commercial relationships and developing the territory beyond inbound interest. The role requires active prospecting for new business, maintaining existing relationships, and collaborating on account strategy. Building and executing a territory sales plan to prioritize security-focused brands and manufacturers. Working with marketing to promote the brand and increase market awareness in prioritized accounts. Developing pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events. Closing contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets and achieve strategic objectives. Managing customer relationships and interactions throughout all stages of the sales cycle. Working with Field Engineers to understand customer requirements and ensure customer satisfaction. Maintaining accurate data and forecasts within Salesforce. Establishing professional relationships with key influencers and decision-makers. Coordinating with colleagues, including support, delivery, and management teams. Required Qualifications and Skills 5-10 years of experience in sales. Technical skills and familiarity with embedded Linux and RTOS. Ability to sell complex technical solutions, including enterprise software, cloud, virtualization, and container technologies, to senior enterprise levels and departments focused on embedded software and IoT devices. Demonstrated ambition and focus for prospecting sales and strategic account development. Professional practice in account planning and continuous pipeline reporting. b6f9e06a6bb68246.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد المخطط، وتقدير كمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان التقيد بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن أعمال الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الكهربائية والمواصفات الفنية. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم الفني. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص، ويقدم الدعم المباشر للمهندسين الكهربائيين في مشاريع الشركة المتنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

b610a1d9d8e49c44.description: About the Role PSA BDP is seeking a Projects & Heavy Lifts Product Manager to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role involves developing and managing business within the projects and heavy lifts sector, focusing on key industrial verticals. The successful candidate will be responsible for both business development and operational oversight of project logistics. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new business opportunities within the Oil & Gas, Energy, Construction, and other industrial sectors in KSA. Nurture and develop relationships with existing and key customers through regular face-to-face meetings. Source vendors, procure rates, and develop solutions for customer requests. Identify project risks and recommend appropriate resolutions. Prepare and submit quotes, proposals, method statements, and transportation plans for prospective and existing clients. Provide onsite support for supervision of loading/unloading, packing, and coordination of project moves. Develop project budgets with a focus on cost optimization and reduction. Conduct regular project status meetings with the project team and provide timely progress updates to customers. b699a647eebe290c.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform recognized as a Great Place to Work®. With over 25 years of conversational AI research and development, Unifonic serves more than 5,000 enterprises across MENA. The company is pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform. The Role of Arabic Linguist – AI & TTS Unifonic is seeking an Arabic Linguist to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This is a part-time position focused on supporting the Text-to-Speech (TTS) team. The role involves linguistic analysis, providing Arabic dialect expertise, evaluating pronunciation and speech quality, and contributing to voice-related projects. The Arabic Linguist will apply linguistic expertise to production projects aimed at enhancing the quality, accuracy, and naturalness of Arabic speech technology. Key Responsibilities Conducting research on the phonological, morphological, and syntactic structures of Arabic, with a focus on Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and Saudi/Gulf dialects (particularly the Najdi dialect), and providing linguistic guidance for their integration into Sestek products. Acting as a linguistic point of contact for the R&D / AI team and translating linguistic requirements into clear, actionable input for engineers. Analyzing and reviewing pronunciation data, including grapheme-to-phoneme mappings, diacritization/tashkeel, and lexicons, for Arabic TTS and speech recognition systems. Evaluating TTS output quality in terms of pronunciation accuracy, prosody, dialect authenticity, and naturalness, with a particular focus on Saudi Arabic. Providing linguistic guidance and support for Arabic voice data collection and speech synthesis projects, including identifying and onboarding suitable voice talents when needed. Supporting the coordination and review of voice recording and editing processes to ensure linguistic accuracy and consistency. Supporting the onboarding and coordination of external Arabic language consultants when needed and providing guidance on linguistic requirements. Reviewing and providing linguistic feedback on data annotation activities and guidelines, ensuring appropriate quality standards for Arabic and Saudi dialect data. Collaborating closely with the Sestek TTS and AI Research teams and providing ongoing linguistic expertise throughout the project. Benefits Unifonic offers a range of benefits to its employees, including a competitive salary and bonus structure. Employees are eligible for the Unifonic share scheme. After the first anniversary, employees receive 30 holiday days annually, in addition to their birthday off. The company also provides the option to work remotely for up to 25 days per year and offers paid leave for new parents.

b65e535af38615c4.description: About the Role Hitachi is seeking an experienced professional for the role of Team Lead - Operation Quality. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, and requires 8-10 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will apply practical knowledge in a high-quality manufacturing or assembly environment, focusing on delivering world-class quality and driving continuous improvements. Key Responsibilities Lead a team of quality engineers and technicians, including planning and implementing team development and achieving performance goals. Arrange and perform shop floor activities related to quality checking of products, incoming material quality, production, and testing processes. Take responsibility for process development, procedures, templates, and working instructions concerning operations quality and incoming quality. Collaborate with and empower all departments for deviation detection, nonconformance follow-ups, root cause analysis, correction measures implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives. Support in resolving quality issues from the GIS assembly line or site, and follow up on NCR-related improvement actions. Attend and participate in internal or external audits (ISO, Hitachi Energy, Customer), working with all departments to close findings and implement improvements. Participate in organizational changes and lean culture implementation within the Business Unit. Implement and monitor the quality strategy for materials, customer complaints, and processes using predefined quality KPIs. Arrange and perform failure analysis, prepare reports using 8D templates or similar, and maintain a safe environment by implementing HSE requirements. Monitor supplier quality performance and follow up on corrective actions related to NCRs, CCRPs, and suppliers. Ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Uphold Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, taking responsibility for personal actions while caring for colleagues and the business. Required Qualifications and Experience 8-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to resolve HV Site Non-conformance issues. Proven experience in a high-quality manufacturing or assembly environment. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic team focused on operational quality and continuous improvement.

b66b3311ae17a0f9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث وكالة اعلانك الماسي للدعاية والاعلان عن مصمم إعلان للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم الإعلانات والمواد الدعائية، وتطوير المفاهيم الإبداعية، واختيار التخطيط والمحتوى المناسبين لضمان تحقيق الأهداف التسويقية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير مفاهيم التصميم العامة للإعلانات والمواد الدعائية، بما في ذلك المنشورات والطوابع ووسائل الإعلام المطبوعة والرقمية. تطوير أسلوب تصميم يتناسب مع الصورة والوضع المرغوبين للعملاء. دراسة أهداف وغايات الإعلان وعناصر التصميم لمخطط الإعلان أو المنشور أو الطوابع بما يتناسب مع مفاهيم التصاميم العامة. تحديد المتطلبات الأسلوبية للتصاميم، مثل الألوان والخطوط والرسومات. العمل مع مزودي المحتوى لضمان إدراجه بفعالية في الإعلان وتحديد عناصر الطوابع أو محتويات المنشورات. ضمان الاتساق التام مع مفاهيم التصميم العامة والمعايير المحددة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال التصميم. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التصميم الإعلاني. إجادة العمل على برنامج Photoshop لتصميم الإعلانات والمواد الدعائية. القدرة على تطوير مفاهيم التصميم والرؤية الإبداعية. مهارات قوية في اختيار التخطيط والمحتوى المناسبين للتصاميم. بيئة العمل العمل في هذا الدور بدوام كامل ضمن مكتب دعاية وإعلان في مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التعاون مع فريق العمل لتقديم حلول تصميمية مبتكرة وفعالة.

b6398582a3ac8168.description: About Alstom Alstom specializes in transport networks, offering a broad portfolio that includes high-speed trains, metros, monorails, trams, turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility solutions. Ensuring the definition of material and information flows at the project's inception. Developing and providing appropriate training for team members to enhance their skills and performance. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize supply chain and planning activities. Driving a culture of resilience, adaptability, and continuous learning within the logistics team. Supporting the continuous improvement of logistics processes to align with business objectives. b650ebb57da6d6c8.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking an Executive Lounge Supervisor to oversee daily operations and deliver exceptional guest experiences in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading service standards, maintaining lounge presentation, and ensuring guest satisfaction for executive and VIP guests. Key Responsibilities Lead daily execution of Executive Lounge service standards to ensure a seamless guest experience. Uphold brand and quality standards to meet the expectations of executive and VIP guests. Respond to guest inquiries and complaints promptly and professionally. About Hilton Hilton is a global leader in hospitality, recognized for its workplace culture and commitment to guest experiences. b663123f3258b99d.description: About 2P Perfect Presentation Since 2004, 2P Perfect Presentation has been a key player in Saudi Arabia’s ICT sector, providing integrated technology solutions to support digital transformation and enhance operational efficiency for organizations. The company focuses on innovation and service excellence, delivering end-to-end solutions through specialized business units and market expertise. Collections Supervisor Role Overview 2P Perfect Presentation is seeking a skilled Collections Supervisor to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing collection operations, managing accounts receivable, and recovering payments from government entities and private-sector clients. The supervisor will ensure timely recovery of outstanding payments, support healthy cash flow, and work to minimize bad debt. Key Responsibilities Supervise the collections team and monitor daily performance. Track due and overdue invoices and establish collection priorities. Communicate directly with clients to follow up on outstanding payments and resolve payment-related issues. Develop collection plans and timelines, and monitor their execution. Prepare periodic management reports on accounts receivable, overdue balances, and collection rates. Coordinate with the Finance and Sales teams to resolve issues related to invoices and contracts. Follow up on the approval and payment of claims and project certificates with government entities in accordance with their procedures. Analyze the causes of payment delays and recommend practical measures to reduce bad debt. Ensure compliance with the company’s approved collection policies and procedures. Build and maintain strong relationships with client representatives to facilitate timely collections. Train, guide, and develop the collections team. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in supervising collection operations. Proven experience in managing accounts receivable. Demonstrated ability to collect payments from government entities in Saudi Arabia. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dynamic environment focused on digital transformation and operational efficiency.

b670a29bf2b82364.description: About Red Sea Global and RSSE Red Sea Global (RSG) is a developer of regenerative tourism destinations. Red Sea Sports & Entertainment (RSSE), a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, is responsible for designing and delivering land and marine experiences at The Red Sea destination. RSSE manages and operates a portfolio of sports, adventure, and leisure offerings, including water sports through Galaxea, adventure activities via Akun, and leisure experiences delivered by WAMA. RSSE supports Saudi Vision 2030 by promoting inclusive, accessible, and world-class sports and recreational experiences. Role Overview: Instructor - Adventure The Instructor - Adventure plays a frontline role within The Red Sea destination, focusing on delivering safe, engaging, and memorable inland adventure experiences under the Akun Adventure portfolio. This full-time position supports the development of diverse trails and adventure activities, ensuring guest experiences align with Red Sea Sport & Entertainment standards. The Instructor collaborates with senior instructors, operations teams, and resort colleagues, leading adventure activities while upholding safety, environmental stewardship, and customer service. Lead guests on Akun Adventure experiences, ensuring safety, engagement, and a premium outdoor experience. Conduct pre-activity briefings, including safety instructions, risk awareness, and experience expectations. Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols, SOPs, RAMS, and emergency procedures during all activities. Educate guests on environmental awareness, conservation principles, and responsible outdoor behavior. Maintain a professional, welcoming, and service-oriented approach when interacting with guests. Monitor weather conditions, terrain, and guest capability, adjusting activity plans as needed. Assist with trail exploration and assessment to identify optimal routes for adventure experiences. Support trip planning, logistics, equipment preparation, and vehicle readiness. Provide feedback, operational insights, and incident reports to the Senior Instructor and RSSE management. Support the maintenance and care of all adventure equipment, ensuring cleanliness and compliance with safety standards. Assist in the training, mentoring, and development of Adventure Specialists and junior team members. Promote and embody the Red Sea service style, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality guest experiences. Comply with all RSSE and Red Sea Global policies, processes, SOPs, and operational guidelines. Support the preparation of accurate and timely operational reports and MIS data. Apply safety, quality, and environmental management policies to ensure employee and guest safety and regulatory compliance. Actively contribute to a strong safety culture by identifying hazards, reporting risks, and supporting risk mitigation. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement across adventure operations and guest experiences. Stakeholder Collaboration The Instructor will collaborate with internal stakeholders including Senior Instructors, Adventure Operations, RSSE Operations Teams, and Resort & Hospitality Teams. b672151e16f5c2ed.description: About Otis Otis is a global leader in elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service, moving billion people daily and maintaining approximately million customer units worldwide. The company operates in over 200 countries and territories, with a team of 72,000 professionals dedicated to meeting diverse customer and passenger needs. Otis is recognized for its legacy of innovation and commitment to safety, ethics, and quality. Role Overview Otis is seeking a Senior Project Engineer for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role is responsible for managing installation projects, ensuring timely completion, and adhering to business policies and procedures. The Senior Project Engineer will oversee manpower planning, equipment requisition, and site progress monitoring, as well as manage variation orders based on client specification changes. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Manage Pre-installation Works: Ensure availability of contractual scope of works and deliveries information. Plan material deliveries in coordination with factory and supply chain. Monitor shaft readiness and verify dimensions against approved shop drawings. Ensure adequate resource planning to meet project requirements. Award Purchase Orders for subcontractors and local materials in conjunction with the Project Manager and supply chain. Coordinate with External Stakeholders: Facilitate approval of shop drawings, technical submittals, material samples, method statements, and Inspection and Test Plans. Plan and arrange logistic programs for safe and timely material deliveries. Submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports to the main contractor as required. Attend weekly/bi-weekly meetings with the main contractor. Advise the main contractor of any scope deviations and process variation orders. Carry out technical coordination and planning for elevator interface with Low Voltage devices. Oversee Installation Phase: Ensure availability of adequate resources, including subcontractors and certified tools. Raise Material Inspection Requests upon material deliveries and approval. Maintain proper communication and record-keeping with the main contractor. Monitor installation progress using MS Projects, Primavera, or spreadsheets. Plan risk assessments for hoisting, rigging, and other critical activities. Conduct Tool Box Talks (TBT)/Field Pre-Task Assessments (FPA) and ensure adherence to safety procedures. Raise trouble reports for missing, short-shipped, or defective materials and follow up on deliveries. Provide advice and support to installation teams for any related issues. Ensure installation manuals, engineering drawings, and approved shop drawings are always available. Coordinate with the supply chain for timely ordering and availability of local materials. Ensure in-stage QA/QC is carried out according to company procedures. Ensure T&C plan and adjustor availability to meet project deadlines. Ensure timely readiness of Construction Time Usage as per project requirements. Ensure timely completion of Low Voltage interfaces to elevator systems. Ensure timely submission of monthly interim payment applications and follow up on payments. Carry out third-party inspections as required. Handover units to customers in line with company policy and project requirements. Coordinate with Internal Departments: Liaise with local engineering, factory, supply chain, and finance teams to fulfill project deliveries. Manage Project Budget: Prepare and present cost reviews to finance and management teams. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in project engineering or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage complex installation projects. Proficiency in project management tools such as MS Projects or Primavera. Strong understanding of safety procedures and quality control. b6a521424b6bf18f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إجراء الأبحاث والتحاليل الكيميائية بهدف تطوير المنتجات والعمليات، بالإضافة إلى تحسين الطرق التحليلية وإعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الأبحاث والتجارب والتحاليل الكمية والنوعية للعناصر والمركبات العضوية واللاعضوية. تحديد الخواص الكيميائية والبنية والتفاعلات للمركبات وتحليل النتائج المستخلصة. تصميم وتطوير وسائل وأساليب وتجهيزات جديدة، وتحسين المعادلات والعمليات والطرق لحل المشكلات الفنية. إجراء الأبحاث على المنتجات الكيميائية المصنعة بهدف تطوير وتحسين الإجراءات والعمليات وجودة المنتجات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بنتائج الدراسات الفيزيائية وسبل تطويرها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الكيمياء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء الأبحاث والتحاليل الكيميائية المعقدة. مهارات قوية في التحليل الكمي والنوعي. بيئة العمل يعمل الكيميائي بدوام كامل في الجبيل بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على الابتكار والتطوير المستمر في مجال الكيمياء. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل يسهم في تطوير المنتجات والعمليات الكيميائية. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل.

b6dbaf413cdb9bc5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة غصون الرعاية الطبية عن مهندس أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان التركيب الفعال، الصيانة، والتشخيص الدقيق للأجهزة الطبية، بالإضافة إلى تدريب المستخدمين على تشغيلها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهندسين حديثي التخرج أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط وبرامج لتركيب الأجهزة الطبية، بما في ذلك أجهزة التصوير الإشعاعي والموجي، وأجهزة التشخيص والمعالجة. تدريب المستخدمين على تشغيل الأجهزة الطبية بكفاءة وأمان. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة الطبية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إجراء الفحوص الدورية للتأكد من دقة أداء الأجهزة الطبية. تطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة شهادة جامعية في هندسة الأجهزة الطبية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الأجهزة الطبية. معرفة قوية بمبادئ تشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة الطبية المختلفة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على إعداد الخطط والبرامج الفنية. مهارات تدريبية جيدة لنقل المعرفة للمستخدمين. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والتوثيق. الالتزام بتطوير الذات ومواكبة التطورات التقنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص في مؤسسة غصون الرعاية الطبية، ملتزماً بتقديم أعلى معايير الجودة في خدمة الأجهزة الطبية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

b6077316a27a8ac4.description: About the Role *** is seeking an experienced MEP Project Engineer to manage and coordinate all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) installation works. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on ensuring MEP systems are delivered in compliance with Saudi Building Code (SBC), Civil Defense requirements, approved designs, safety standards, and project schedules, while maintaining high quality and cost control. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage all on-site MEP installation activities, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and ELV systems. Coordinate MEP works with civil, structural, and architectural teams to ensure smooth interfaces and sequencing, avoiding conflicts and delays. Review and coordinate MEP shop drawings, material submittals, and technical clarifications with consultants and subcontractors. Ensure all MEP installations comply with Saudi Building Code (SBC), Saudi Civil Defense, SEC, NWC, and other relevant authority requirements. Manage and supervise MEP subcontractors and site labor to ensure productivity, quality, and safety compliance. Coordinate inspections and approvals with Saudi Civil Defense and other local authorities related to MEP systems. Support procurement activities by reviewing technical specifications and assisting in supplier and material evaluations. Monitor and report MEP installation progress against the project schedule, and coordinate testing, commissioning, and pre-commissioning activities. Identify and resolve technical, quality, safety, and progress-related issues on site, proposing constructability improvements and value engineering solutions. Identify, manage, and mitigate interface risks arising from split contracts and multiple subcontractors, maintaining a live interface risk register. Technical Coordination and Compliance The role involves ensuring that all MEP installations adhere to regulatory standards and approved designs. This includes supporting the resolution of design conflicts and site technical issues, as well as coordinating with various authorities for necessary approvals and certifications. The engineer will be responsible for ensuring materials and equipment meet approved submittals and project specifications. Subcontractor and Quality Management Effective management of MEP subcontractors and site labor is crucial to ensure productivity, quality, and safety compliance. This includes monitoring workmanship through inspections and site checks, enforcing quality standards, and ensuring adherence to approved safety plans and HSE procedures. The role also involves managing cross-trade coordination meetings to resolve interface-related conflicts. Project Progress and Documentation Monitoring and reporting MEP installation progress against the project schedule is a core responsibility. The engineer will coordinate testing, commissioning, and pre-commissioning activities for all MEP systems. Furthermore, ensuring proper documentation, including as-built drawings and O&M manuals, is prepared for handover is essential. Experience and Location This position requires 5-10 years of experience in MEP project engineering. The role is full-time and will be based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will contribute to ***'s projects by ensuring high standards of MEP installation and coordination.

b69d01ceb0c99086.description: نبذة عن الدور يقدم مصرف الراجحي فرصة وظيفية لاستشاري مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. يشمل هذا الدور، الذي يتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، العمل بدوام كامل في مدن مثل الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، القطيف، بقيق، راس تنورة، صفوى، الجش، عنك، دارين، العمران، المبرز، والجفر. يركز الدور على تقديم المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية للعملاء بمستوى عالٍ من الجودة والاحترافية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى استشاري المبيعات مجموعة من المهام الأساسية التي تضمن سير العمليات المصرفية بسلاسة وفعالية، مع التركيز على خدمة العملاء وتلبية احتياجاتهم. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: استقبال طلبات بيع المنتجات المصرفية ومتابعة إدخالها وتنفيذها على الأنظمة المخصصة. مساعدة العملاء في فتح الحسابات، استيفاء المستندات المطلوبة، إدخال البيانات والتوقيعات في النظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. ترحيل العقود والحسابات عبر البريد إلى مركز المعلومات وعلى نظام إدارة المستندات (DMS). استقبال العملاء في الفرع وتقديم الخدمة المطلوبة، مع توجيههم لإتمام معاملاتهم بشكل صحيح. مساعدة العملاء في تعبئة النماذج اللازمة وتوجيههم لاستخدام أجهزة الصراف الآلي والقنوات الإلكترونية. الاستجابة السريعة لمشاكل العملاء وتلبية طلباتهم وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة، والمتابعة مع مراقب الفرع لحل المشكلات. استلام طلبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي، إدخالها في النظام، طباعة البطاقات الفورية، وتسليم البطاقات المجددة. استقبال طلبات تحديث البيانات، قفل الحسابات، وتعديل بيانات الحسابات وتسليمها لمدير العمليات. التعامل مع العملاء الموكلين، استكمال بيانات نماذج التوكيل، مطابقة التوقيعات، وإدخالها في النظام. استيفاء الأوامر المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات لاستكمال التنفيذ. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وتحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في نظام مطالبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي. تحويل مشاكل العملاء إلى مدير العمليات للعمل على حلها. الاستعلام عن البطاقات الائتمانية وبطاقات الصراف الآلي المسحوبة في الفرع وتوجيه العملاء لاستلامها. تزويد العملاء بمنشورات المنتجات المصرفية. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن أي حالات مخالفة للأنظمة والتعليمات. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحين يمتلكون المهارات الأساسية لخدمة العملاء والتعامل مع العمليات المصرفية. يجب أن تتوافر في المتقدمين المؤهلات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة إدخال البيانات المصرفية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم خدمة عملاء احترافية. الالتزام بالدقة والاحترافية في إنجاز المهام. بيئة العمل يُعد هذا الدور وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصرف الراجحي في المنطقة الشرقية، مما يوفر بيئة عمل داعمة ومحفزة لتطوير المهارات المصرفية وخدمة العملاء. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة في مصرف الراجحي.

b6b0b379d45dc924.description: About the Role Base Career is seeking a Data QA Engineer to join a partner company based in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data delivered to customers, particularly within web data extraction projects and AI-assisted solutions. The position emphasizes early defect prevention rather than final quality checkpoints. Role Context and Responsibilities The Data QA Engineer will translate customer requirements into measurable quality standards, combining exploratory testing, data analysis, and automation. The role operates within a globally distributed, multicultural team that values ownership and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will take ownership of quality assurance from the initial stages of new projects. Translate customer data extraction and web scraping requirements into clear, testable criteria and comprehensive QA strategies. Perform exploratory, manual, and visual testing, complemented by automated testing where valuable. Execute test cycles on extracted datasets to validate compliance with customer specifications and identify defects. Document defects clearly, providing reproducible steps and supporting evidence for efficient resolution. Apply descriptive statistics, data summaries, and visualizations to assess data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and drift. Prepare quality reports and scoring metrics to communicate results to internal teams and customers. Identify the scope of testing, untested areas, and associated risks to support informed project decisions. Collaborate with project managers and customers to clarify ambiguous requirements and ensure measurability before QA begins. Contribute to the development and improvement of test automation frameworks, focusing on coverage, reliability, and performance. Identify, propose, and implement improvements to QA processes and tooling. Work independently while maintaining close collaboration with QA leadership, developers, and project managers. Qualifications and Experience At least 5-10 years of experience as a QA Engineer or in a comparable role involving software testing, data testing, or data quality assurance. Proficiency in Python for data analysis and validation, preferably using Pandas and Jupyter notebooks. Basic to intermediate SQL skills, including the ability to query and validate data in at least one relational database environment. Strong understanding of web technologies and protocols, including HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP, and CSS. Experience testing HTTP/REST APIs and validating responses against requirements. Solid knowledge of test case design, test data management, and practical approaches to exploratory and automated testing. Understanding of data quality principles, particularly completeness, accuracy, consistency, and data drift. Experience working in an Agile environment (*, Scrum or Kanban) and collaborating effectively with developers. Familiarity with AI and large language model (LLM) tools to improve test case generation and accelerate data validation workflows. A proactive, detail-oriented mindset with strong ownership of project quality and the confidence to uphold standards under delivery pressure. Ability to learn new technologies quickly, understand complex project requirements, and adapt testing strategies. Strong written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly and precisely. Preferred Skills Practical knowledge of Scrapy or other Python-based web scraping frameworks. Experience working with test automation frameworks. An interest in data science concepts and their application to data analysis and validation. Enthusiasm for exploring AI and LLM-powered approaches to improve data quality assurance. Work Environment This role is for a partner company of Base Career, which manages all applications and subsequent steps. The team is globally distributed and multicultural, promoting flexible ways of working. Application Process Applications for this position will be managed directly by Base Career's partner company. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon initial contact.
